deferral_rationale: Dismissed as binding concern (standing recommendation only): verified _gpu_mem_all_zero('0,,0',64) is True, but the identical empty-token-dropping semantics pre-exist on trunk in _gpu_idle('0,,0') → True (probed), where they feed the STALL conjunction, a more consequential consumer than this advisory. Plan v2 SS4.1(d) documents the parser reuse as-is. Realistic malformed shapes (unknown, [N/A], non-int tokens) all fail safe to False; an empty token needs a blank nvidia-smi line sustained over min_ticks=3 consecutive samples; cost is one advisory marker + push, nothing stopped. Strict-memory-parser hardening belongs in the same follow-up as the corrupt-state normalization.
